seo.title: Meal vouchers: everything you need to know about the regulations in force in 2026
seo.description: The extension of the use of luncheon vouchers in supermarkets until the end of 2026 represents a challenge for fast-food outlets, but find out how to turn this constraint into an opportunity for your establishment!

fields.rt-blog-html:
Luncheon vouchers are an essential part of everyday life for many employees and restaurateurs. However, with the extension of their use in supermarkets until the end of 2026, many restaurant professionals, particularly fast-food operators, are wondering about the impact of this measure on their business. Many questions are being asked: what's changing, what isn't, and above all, how can they adapt to this temporary extension? We take a look at the situation for you, fast-food managers, so that you can make the most of meal vouchers in your outlet.

‍

History and operation of luncheon vouchers

The origins of luncheon vouchers in France

Luncheon vouchers were introduced at the end of the 1960s, in response to a social problem: enabling employees to eat lunch when they didn't have access to a company canteen or restaurant. Since their introduction, their objective has remained clear: to promote a balanced, affordable diet for employees, while benefiting from tax advantages for employers.

Over the decades, luncheon vouchers have evolved from the classic paper format to rechargeable cards and mobile applications, making them easier to use and adapted to new consumer habits. Today, they are one of the most popular employee benefits in France. (Source: History of luncheon vouchers - CNTR)

Rules for using meal vouchers in 2026

Meal vouchers, whether in paper or digital form, are a form of payment used by 5.5 million employees in France to pay for their meals (2026 figures: economie.gouv).

A few rules to know:

  • Allocation: Employers are not obliged to offer luncheon vouchers, but if they do, they decide how many are allocated to their employees.
  • Use: Employees can spend up to €25 a day on meal vouchers.
  • Limitations of paper tickets: Unlike digital versions, retailers and restaurateurs do not give change for paper tickets.
  • Approval required: If you wish to accept luncheon vouchers in your fast-food restaurant, you must apply for approval from the Commission Nationale des Titres-Restaurant (CNTR).
  • Flexibility for restaurateurs : each chain is free to define which products are eligible for payment with luncheon vouchers.

‍

A reform expected by restaurateurs, but postponed

Initially, a reform of meal vouchers was due to come into force at the beginning of 2025. The aim was to limit their use for food shopping in supermarkets, and refocus their use on meals consumed in restaurants. This project echoed the demands of restaurant owners, who were hoping for a return of customers to their establishments.

However, the political context upset this trajectory. The government behind the reform, led by Michel Barnier, was overthrown in December 2024. This change of direction froze the process, leaving the reform in abeyance. To put an end to the vagueness and uncertainty, on January 14, 2025, the Senate voted to extend the use of luncheon vouchers in supermarkets. This means that employees can continue to use their luncheon vouchers to buy food products in supermarkets, including items that cannot be consumed immediately (pasta, rice, meat, etc.), until December 31, 2026.

For fast-food managers, this extension is seen as a major challenge, as it will continue to reduce their market share. In two years, the use of meal vouchers in restaurants has fallen from 46% to 40%, according to a study by the National Commission for Meal Vouchers (CNTR) (Source: publicsenat.fr). By maintaining competition with supermarkets, this extension risks slowing down the return of employees to restaurants.

Restaurateurs therefore need to adapt their strategies to this transitional context, while preparing for possible future changes.

‍

How can fast-food managers take advantage of meal vouchers in 2026?

Despite this difficult context, meal vouchers offer many opportunities for fast-food outlets. Here are just a few of the possibilities:

Increase your average shopping basket with luncheon vouchers

To boost sales, adapt your pricing strategy. Propose menus or special offers that encourage customers to use their full daily limit (€25). For example:

  • Combined packages at attractive prices.
  • Complementary products to encourage customers to increase their average ticket.

👉 To find out more: 8 tips to increase your average food service bill

Build customer loyalty with targeted offers

Integrating luncheon vouchers into your loyalty programs can create significant leverage. Here are a few ideas:

  • Offer bonus loyalty points for every payment made with a meal voucher.
  • Offer targeted discounts or promotions based on your customers' buying habits. Analyzing transaction data can help you personalize your offers.

Choose the right POS system

In 2026, digital meal vouchers are becoming increasingly widespread (they will be mandatory from 2027), gradually replacing paper versions. A modern payment system such as IO Pay is therefore essential for optimizing the management of digital meal vouchers:

  • System compatible with all your digital solutions: payment terminals, checkouts or order terminals equipped with contactless payment (SoftPos), intelligent tray scanning, etc.
  • Accepts all types of payment: credit cards (CB, Visa, Mastercard, Amex), wallets (Apple Pay, Google Pay), restaurant vouchers (Edenred, Swile, etc.), etc.
  • Able to manage transactions linked to specific ceilings or restrictions.
  • Easy to integrate with analysis and reporting tools.

Keep track of your performance

Using a high-performance back-office enables you to track meal-ticket transactions. This can help you identify the most profitable periods and adjust your sales strategies accordingly.

The extension of the expanded use of meal vouchers until December 2026 may seem like a hindrance for fast-food restaurants, but it also represents an opportunity. Innovorder, an expert in the digitization of fast-food restaurants, can help you adapt your pricing strategies, tools, and loyalty programs to grow your business in this context.
